description: Start the FastAPI/uvicorn HTTPS callback server that handles the Google OAuth redirect. Must be running before the operator completes the browser flow. A local solet defaults to explicit IPv4 loopback (127.0.0.1); an ALB-fronted cloud deployment must configure 0.0.0.0 explicitly and routes /oauth/google/* by path rule to this task's port. Runs as a background job and needs no connected account: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the bound host, port, and callback URL arrive via a follow-up message once the socket is bound (read it any time with service_interface::job_service::get_job).
embedding_description: Launch the Google Workspace OAuth redirect listener before connect_account. Serves GET /oauth/google/callback, validates state and PKCE, exchanges the authorization code, and vaults tokens. Local default: 127.0.0.1. For ALB-fronted cloud, explicitly bind 0.0.0.0 and route /oauth/google/* to this port. Completion delivers host, port, callback_url.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Google OAuth callback server start queued
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the callback server start (job_id, status queued); the finished job's result is the bound host, the allocated port, the callback_url and a message. Completion is delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Say the callback server is starting. Once completion confirms it is listening, state the callback_url and note that connect_account can now be run.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Start the Google OAuth callback uvicorn server.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: service_not_available (refused at dispatch): the vault or address-book service the callback needs was not injected at readiness. callback_server_start_failed (in the finished job): the uvicorn server could not bind its socket within the five-second startup window — almost always another process already listening on that port, occasionally a host the process may not bind. The message carries the host, the port, and the underlying bind error. gsuite.invalid_params at dispatch means the session_id/flow_id context is missing; an unparseable port is refused at dispatch too. gsuite.api_error at dispatch means the job could not be queued (AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: service_not_available: confirm the plugin reached readiness (vault + address_book bound). Check plugin load logs; retry after the platform is fully started. callback_server_start_failed: find what already holds the port (lsof -nP -iTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN), then either stop that process or call start_interface again with an explicit free port. Never treat this error as cosmetic — the callback server is NOT listening, so the Google redirect would land on whatever else owns the port and the browser flow cannot complete. gsuite.api_error at dispatch: retry once platform startup has completed.
